{% comment %} REQ: LANG-931 LANG-932 LANG-933 {% endcomment %} <h1>{{ product.title | upcase }}</h1> {% assign total = 0 %} <ul> {% for variant in product.variants limit: 3 %} <li class="{% cycle 'odd', 'even' %}">{{ variant.title }} - {{ variant.price | money }}</li> {% assign total = total | plus: 1 %} {% else %} <li>No variants</li> {% endfor %} </ul> {% if customer and customer.tags contains "vip" %} <p>Welcome back, {{ customer.first_name | default: "friend" }}!</p> {% elsif product.available == false %} <p>Sold out ({{ total }})</p> {% endif %} {%- capture greeting -%}Hello, {{ shop.name }}{%- endcapture -%} {{ greeting | strip }} {{ nil }} {{ empty }}
